Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for speaking with us. We're excited to move forward with the IC loop. Quick scheduling note and a couple logistics/questions so we can make the day smooth: 

1) Proposed slots (PT) — please confirm which works best:
   • Tue Jul 25, 10:00–12:00
   • Wed Jul 26, 13:00–15:00

2) Rough flow (we'll send a formal agenda + Zoom):
   • 10m intro + culture/candidate Qs
   • 40m system design (Aditya)
   • 30m coding pair (live editor)
   • 20m closing + benefits/next steps

3) Accessibility / preferences: if you need live captions, extra time for sections, or an ASL interpreter, let us know and we will arrange. We can also provide a separate quiet room Zoom or extend break windows.

4) ID / check-in: if you’re coming on-site later, we typically ask for a government ID on arrival. For virtual only, no ID needed.

Please reply with the preferred slot and any accommodations. Mina (cc'd) will publish the calendar invite and Zoom once we confirm.

Best,
